introduction: The merge queue serializes integration operations for the af-hub campaign execution system, providing a FIFO queue with rebase-then-fast-forward semantics that prevents merge races, dirty repository states, and silent work loss when multiple agents complete work on separate spec branches concurrently.

glossary.AlreadyMerged: CantMergeReason value indicating the source branch is already integrated into the target
glossary.BeforeDependency: CantMergeReason value indicating an upstream spec has not yet been merged
glossary.BranchNotReady: CantMergeReason value indicating no new commits exist on the source branch
glossary.CHECK_COMMAND: Workspace variable containing the shell command to run after rebase as a post-rebase check; executed via sh -c
glossary.CHECK_TIMEOUT: Workspace variable specifying the timeout for CHECK_COMMAND execution (e.g. 5m, 15m); defaults to 10 minutes
glossary.CanMerge: Package-level function in internal/mergequeue that evaluates whether a merge job is eligible to proceed, returning (bool, CantMergeReason, error)
glossary.CantMergeReason: Typed Go enum returned by CanMerge indicating why a merge cannot proceed (BeforeDependency, WouldConflict, AlreadyMerged, BranchNotReady, SpecBlocked)
glossary.GetAuthInfo: apikit function that retrieves the authenticated caller's identity (UUID and scopes) from the request context
glossary.GitRunner: Struct from internal/gitcmd that executes git subprocesses with safety environment defaults
glossary.InitSchema: Function in store.go that applies the merge_jobs table schema at startup using CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS
glossary.MergeJob: Go struct representing a single merge request with all fields from the merge_jobs table
glossary.PostMergeHook: Function type injected at Queue construction time, called after a successful merge to notify the campaign scheduler
glossary.RunExitCode: GitRunner method that executes a git command and returns the raw exit code and combined output without treating non-zero exits as errors
glossary.SpecBlocked: CantMergeReason value indicating the spec is in blocked status in the campaign
glossary.WORKSPACE_ROOT: Environment variable or configuration value specifying the root directory where workspace repositories are stored on disk
glossary.WouldConflict: CantMergeReason value indicating a dry-run detected merge conflicts
glossary.after: Cursor-based pagination query parameter containing the UUID of the last job seen on the previous page
glossary.available_at: RFC 3339 timestamp column on merge_jobs controlling when a queued job becomes visible to the worker; set to now() on creation, set to a future time during backoff
glossary.base_sha: SHA of the target branch HEAD recorded when a merge job transitions to running status
glossary.campaign_id: Nullable UUID linking a merge job to a campaign; NULL for standalone merges
glossary.cancelled: Terminal merge job status indicating the job was cancelled by the user while in queued status
glossary.check_failed: Terminal merge job status indicating the post-rebase check command failed
glossary.check_output: Captured stdout and stderr from the CHECK_COMMAND execution, stored on failure
glossary.conflict: Terminal merge job status indicating a rebase or dry-run detected merge conflicts
glossary.conflict_details: JSON array of conflicting file paths stored as TEXT in SQLite; deserialized to a native JSON array by the HTTP handler before responding
glossary.dead_letter: Terminal merge job status assigned after exceeding max retries (20); requires operator intervention via the requeue endpoint
glossary.existing_job_id: Field in HTTP 409 Conflict responses identifying the UUID of the conflicting active merge job
glossary.idx_merge_jobs_available: SQLite index on (status, available_at) used by the worker polling query
glossary.idx_merge_jobs_campaign: SQLite index on (campaign_id, status) used by campaign-scoped queries
glossary.idx_merge_jobs_workspace: SQLite index on (workspace_slug, status, created_at) used by list queries
glossary.merge_jobs: SQLite table storing merge job records with lifecycle state, retry metadata, and git operation results
glossary.merged: Terminal merge job status indicating successful integration
glossary.merged_sha: SHA of the target branch HEAD after a successful fast-forward push
glossary.merges:read: PAT scope granting permission to query and list merge jobs
glossary.merges:write: PAT scope granting permission to submit, cancel, and requeue merge jobs
glossary.next_cursor: Pagination field in list responses containing the UUID of the last item on the current page, or null when no further pages exist
glossary.nonce: Server-generated UUID stored in the merge_jobs table for idempotency; never exposed in API responses or accepted from callers
glossary.prepared: Initial merge job status after INSERT; not yet visible to the queue worker
glossary.processMergeJob: Internal function in merge.go that executes the full merge algorithm for a single job
glossary.push_failed: Terminal merge job status indicating the fast-forward push to origin failed
glossary.queued: Merge job status indicating the job is ready for processing by the worker
glossary.rejection_reason: Nullable column storing the CantMergeReason enum value when a merge job is rejected
glossary.retry_count: Integer count of how many times a merge job has been retried due to retriable failures
glossary.running: Merge job status indicating the job is actively being processed (rebase + check + push)
glossary.source_ref: Git branch name to merge from (e.g. spec/07-secrets-variables)
glossary.spec_id: Nullable identifier of the spec being merged, inferred from source_ref by the handler
glossary.stopCh: Channel closed by Stop() to broadcast a shutdown signal to all worker goroutines
glossary.stopWaitGroup: sync.WaitGroup used to block until all in-flight merge operations complete during graceful shutdown
glossary.submitted_by: UUID of the authenticated user or agent who submitted the merge job, populated by the handler from GetAuthInfo and never accepted from request bodies
glossary.target_branch: Git branch name to merge into (e.g. main)
glossary.wakeup channel: Buffered(1) channel used to interrupt the worker's poll sleep when a new job is enqueued
glossary.workspace_slug: URL-safe identifier for a workspace, used as a path parameter and foreign key
glossary.merge_job_id: Structured log field containing the UUID of the merge job being processed; used for correlating log entries across the merge lifecycle
glossary.CanMerge(ctx, db, job): Call signature of the CanMerge function; see CanMerge
glossary.GitRunner.RunExitCode: Method on GitRunner that executes a git command and returns the raw exit code without treating non-zero exits as errors; see RunExitCode
glossary.GitRunner.Run: Method on GitRunner that executes a git command and returns output or *GitError on non-zero exit; see GitRunner
glossary.PostMergeHook(ctx, job): Call signature of the PostMergeHook function type; see PostMergeHook
glossary.(workspace_slug, source_ref): Composite key used by the duplicate submission guard to enforce at most one active merge job per source branch per workspace
glossary.limit: Query parameter on the list endpoint controlling the maximum number of items per page; defaults to 50, maximum 100
glossary.status: Query parameter on the list endpoint for filtering merge jobs by a single status value from the allowed set
glossary.NewQueue: Constructor function that creates and returns a new merge Queue; accepts a database handle and an optional PostMergeHook

requirements.title: Merge Job Data Model and Schema Initialization

user_story.goal: have merge job records persisted in a well-defined SQLite schema with all required fields and indexes
user_story.benefit: merge operations can be tracked, queried, and recovered across process restarts

acceptance_criteria.action: executes CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for `merge_jobs` with all columns (id, `nonce`, `campaign_id`, `spec_id`, `workspace_slug`, `target_branch`, `source_ref`, status, `rejection_reason`, `retry_count`, `available_at`, `base_sha`, `merged_sha`, `conflict_details`, `check_output`, `submitted_by`, created_at, updated_at) and creates indexes `idx_merge_jobs_campaign`, `idx_merge_jobs_workspace`, and `idx_merge_jobs_available`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns nil on success; returns a non-nil error if the DDL fails
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the hub process starts

acceptance_criteria.action: enforces a CHECK constraint on status accepting only: prepared, `queued`, `running`, `merged`, `conflict`, `check_failed`, `cancelled`, `push_failed`, `dead_letter`
enforces a UNIQUE constraint on `nonce` and a NOT NULL constraint on `workspace_slug`, `target_branch`, `source_ref`, status, `retry_count`, `available_at`, `submitted_by`, created_at, updated_at

edge_cases.action: returns the database error to the caller without calling os.Exit
edge_cases.return_contract: returns a non-nil error describing the DDL failure
edge_cases.error_condition: the SQLite database file is read-only or the DDL statement fails

edge_cases.action: completes without error and without altering existing data, because CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS is idempotent
edge_cases.return_contract: returns nil
edge_cases.trigger: `InitSchema` is called on a database that already contains the `merge_jobs` table

user_story.goal: have merge jobs follow a well-defined state machine with typed transitions
user_story.benefit: the system can route jobs correctly and prevent invalid state transitions

acceptance_criteria.action: enforces the state machine: `prepared` → `queued` → `running` → `merged`; from `running`: → `conflict`, → `check_failed`, → `push_failed`; from `queued`: → `cancelled`, → `dead_letter`
transitions the job to `running` status and begins processing
acceptance_criteria.state: a job is in `queued` status and `available_at` <= now()

acceptance_criteria.action: transitions the job to `merged` status and records `merged_sha`
acceptance_criteria.state: a job is in `running` status and all merge steps succeed

edge_cases.action: rejects the transition and logs an error with the `merge_job_id`
edge_cases.return_contract: returns a non-nil error to the caller
edge_cases.error_condition: an attempt is made to transition a job from `merged`, `conflict`, `check_failed`, `push_failed`, `cancelled`, or `dead_letter` to any other status

edge_cases.action: treats the job as stale and does not re-execute it; logs a warning with the `merge_job_id`
edge_cases.return_contract: the worker does not re-execute the stale job; no status transition occurs
edge_cases.error_condition: a job in `running` status is found in the database at worker startup (indicating a crash during a previous run)

requirements.title: CanMerge Pre-Check with Typed Rejection Reasons

user_story.goal: evaluate whether a merge job is eligible to proceed before acquiring the mutex
user_story.benefit: ineligible jobs are deferred or rejected early without holding the per-target-branch lock

acceptance_criteria.action: returns (true, "", nil) indicating the merge may proceed
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (true, "", nil)
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the merge queue worker calls `CanMerge(ctx, db, job)` for a job where all prerequisites are satisfied

acceptance_criteria.action: returns (false, `BeforeDependency`, nil)
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (false, BeforeDependency, nil)
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the merge queue worker calls `CanMerge` for a job where an upstream spec has not yet been merged

acceptance_criteria.action: returns (false, `AlreadyMerged`, nil)
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (false, AlreadyMerged, nil)
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the merge queue worker calls `CanMerge` for a job where the source branch is already integrated

acceptance_criteria.action: returns (false, `BranchNotReady`, nil)
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (false, BranchNotReady, nil)
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the merge queue worker calls `CanMerge` for a job where no new commits exist on `source_ref`

acceptance_criteria.action: returns (false, `SpecBlocked`, nil)
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (false, SpecBlocked, nil)
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the merge queue worker calls `CanMerge` for a job where the spec is in blocked status in the campaign

acceptance_criteria.action: skips the `BeforeDependency` and `SpecBlocked` checks and evaluates only branch-readiness conditions
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (true, "", nil) when branch-readiness conditions pass

edge_cases.action: returns (false, "", err) with the database error
edge_cases.return_contract: returns (false, "", non-nil error)
edge_cases.error_condition: a database query inside `CanMerge` fails with an unexpected error

edge_cases.action: returns immediately with the context error without executing database queries
edge_cases.return_contract: returns (false, "", context.Canceled or context.DeadlineExceeded)
edge_cases.error_condition: the context passed to `CanMerge` is already cancelled

user_story.goal: detect merge conflicts before acquiring the per-target-branch mutex
user_story.benefit: obviously conflicting merges are rejected early without dirtying the integration branch or holding the lock

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `GitRunner.RunExitCode` with args "merge-tree", "--write-tree", targetHead, sourceHead before acquiring the per-target-branch mutex
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns exit code 0 when no conflicts are detected
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the worker begins processing a merge job after `CanMerge` returns true

acceptance_criteria.action: parses conflicting file paths from the merge-tree stderr output following git's standard conflict-reporting format, sets job status to `conflict`, stores the parsed paths in `conflict_details`, and skips the real rebase
acceptance_criteria.trigger: `RunExitCode` returns a non-zero exit code from merge-tree

acceptance_criteria.action: performs the dry-run conflict check outside the per-target-branch mutex as a best-effort early exit; the real rebase inside the mutex is the authoritative conflict check

edge_cases.action: transitions the job to `conflict` status with the conflict file paths from the real rebase; the integration branch is never left in a dirty state
edge_cases.return_contract: job status is set to conflict with conflict_details populated from the real rebase; the integration branch is left clean
edge_cases.error_condition: the dry-run passes but the real rebase inside the mutex detects a conflict (TOCTOU window: a concurrent merge completed between the dry-run and the rebase)

edge_cases.action: logs the error with `merge_job_id` and re-enqueues the job with backoff rather than marking it as `conflict`
edge_cases.return_contract: the job remains in queued status with retry_count incremented and available_at set to a future timestamp
edge_cases.error_condition: `RunExitCode` returns a non-nil error (not a non-zero exit code) during the merge-tree dry-run, indicating a subprocess failure

edge_cases.action: the context cancellation kills the subprocess; the job is not transitioned to `conflict` and is re-enqueued with backoff
edge_cases.return_contract: the job remains in queued status with retry_count incremented and available_at set to a future timestamp
edge_cases.error_condition: the merge-tree subprocess hangs and does not return within the operation's context deadline

requirements.title: Merge Algorithm: Fetch, Rebase, Check, Push

user_story.goal: integrate a source branch into the target branch using rebase-then-fast-forward semantics inside the per-target-branch mutex
user_story.benefit: merges are serialized and the integration branch is always left in a clean state

acceptance_criteria.action: acquires the per-target-branch mutex, validates the `nonce` against the database record, sets status to `running`, records `base_sha` from the current target HEAD, then calls `GitRunner.Run` with args "fetch", "origin", targetBranch
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the dry-run conflict check passes

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `GitRunner.Run` with args "rebase", "origin/<targetBranch>" to rebase `source_ref` onto the freshly fetched remote tracking ref
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the fetch succeeds

acceptance_criteria.action: executes `CHECK_COMMAND` via sh -c with a working directory of <`WORKSPACE_ROOT`>/<slug>/trunk, captures stdout and stderr, and enforces the `CHECK_TIMEOUT` (defaulting to 10 minutes) using os/exec.CommandContext
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the rebase succeeds and `CHECK_COMMAND` is configured

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `GitRunner.Run` with args "push", "origin", targetBranch to fast-forward push the rebased HEAD, then sets status to `merged` and records `merged_sha`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the check step passes (or is skipped because `CHECK_COMMAND` is not configured)

acceptance_criteria.action: invokes `PostMergeHook(ctx, job)` synchronously; if the hook returns an error, logs the error with `merge_job_id` but does not change the job status from `merged`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the job status is set to `merged` and `campaign_id` is non-NULL

edge_cases.action: calls `GitRunner.Run` with args "diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=U" to collect unmerged file paths, then calls `GitRunner.Run` with args "rebase", "--abort"; sets status to `conflict` and stores the collected paths in `conflict_details`; releases the mutex; errors from the diff or abort commands are logged but do not change the `conflict` outcome
edge_cases.return_contract: job status is set to conflict with conflict_details populated; the mutex is released and the integration branch is left clean after rebase --abort
edge_cases.error_condition: git rebase exits with a non-zero exit code indicating a conflict

edge_cases.action: sets job status to `check_failed`, stores captured stdout and stderr in `check_output`, and releases the mutex
edge_cases.return_contract: job status is set to check_failed with check_output containing the captured stdout and stderr; the mutex is released
edge_cases.error_condition: the check command exits with a non-zero exit code

edge_cases.action: sets job status to `push_failed` and releases the mutex
edge_cases.return_contract: job status is set to push_failed; the mutex is released
edge_cases.error_condition: the fast-forward push fails (e.g. the remote rejected the push)

edge_cases.action: discards the job without executing the merge and releases the mutex
edge_cases.return_contract: the job is discarded without executing; no git operations are performed; the mutex is released
edge_cases.error_condition: the `nonce` in the database record does not match the job's `nonce` at the point of validation inside the mutex

edge_cases.action: os/exec.CommandContext cancels and kills the subprocess; sets job status to `check_failed` and stores the timeout error message in `check_output`
edge_cases.return_contract: job status is set to check_failed with check_output containing a timeout error message; the mutex is released
edge_cases.error_condition: the check command exceeds the `CHECK_TIMEOUT` duration

edge_cases.action: sets job status to `check_failed` and records the error in `check_output`
edge_cases.return_contract: job status is set to check_failed with check_output containing the variable store error; the mutex is released
edge_cases.error_condition: fetching `CHECK_COMMAND` from the workspace variables store fails (e.g. secret-store error)

edge_cases.action: the context cancellation kills the subprocess; the job is re-enqueued with backoff and the mutex is released
edge_cases.return_contract: the job remains in queued status with retry_count incremented and available_at set to a future timestamp; the mutex is released
edge_cases.error_condition: the git fetch subprocess hangs and does not return

user_story.goal: re-enqueue retriable failed jobs with exponentially increasing delays and move permanently failing jobs to dead-letter status
user_story.benefit: transient failures are retried automatically while permanently stuck jobs are surfaced for operator intervention

acceptance_criteria.action: re-enqueues the job by setting `available_at` to now() + (2s × 2^`retry_count`) capped at 2 hours per attempt, increments `retry_count`, and leaves status as `queued`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: `CanMerge` returns `BeforeDependency`, `BranchNotReady`, or `SpecBlocked`

acceptance_criteria.action: transitions the job to `dead_letter` status and preserves the `rejection_reason` from the last failure
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a retriable job's `retry_count` reaches 20

acceptance_criteria.action: filters `merge_jobs` with WHERE status = 'queued' AND `available_at` <= now() using `idx_merge_jobs_available`

edge_cases.action: caps each individual retry delay at 2 hours regardless of `retry_count`; retries 12 through 20 each use the 2-hour cap
logs the error with `merge_job_id` and does not crash the worker goroutine
edge_cases.return_contract: the error is logged with merge_job_id; the worker goroutine continues running
edge_cases.error_condition: the database update to set `available_at` for a backoff re-enqueue fails

user_story.goal: use a two-phase prepare-then-enqueue pattern with server-generated nonces to prevent double-merges
user_story.benefit: crashes, retries, and transaction rollbacks cannot cause the same merge to execute twice

acceptance_criteria.action: generates a UUID `nonce` server-side, INSERTs a `merge_jobs` record with status=`prepared` and `available_at`=now() inside the caller's database transaction, then sends the job ID to the queue channel setting status to `queued`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 202 Accepted with the merge job object
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a caller submits a valid merge request

acceptance_criteria.action: fetches the record from the database, validates the `nonce` matches, and checks that status is `prepared` or `queued` before executing; if status is `running` or `merged`, skips; if no record exists (caller's transaction rolled back), discards
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the worker dequeues a job ID from the channel

acceptance_criteria.action: never accepts a `nonce` value from external API callers; the `nonce` is always server-generated and is never included in any API response

edge_cases.action: the worker finds no record for the job ID and discards the job without error
edge_cases.return_contract: the worker discards the job without error; no merge is executed
edge_cases.error_condition: the caller's database transaction is rolled back after the job ID is sent to the queue channel

edge_cases.action: the second dequeue finds status=`running` or `merged` and skips execution
edge_cases.return_contract: the worker skips execution; no duplicate merge occurs
edge_cases.error_condition: the worker receives the same job ID twice on the queue channel (e.g. due to a retry)

user_story.goal: be prevented from submitting a duplicate merge for a source branch that already has an active job
user_story.benefit: at most one merge job per (workspace_slug, source_ref) pair is in queued or running status at any time

acceptance_criteria.action: returns HTTP 409 Conflict with a JSON body containing the `existing_job_id` of the conflicting job
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 409 with body {"error": "merge already in progress for this source branch", "existing_job_id": "UUID"}
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a caller submits a merge request for a `(workspace_slug, source_ref)` pair that already has a job in `queued` or `running` status

acceptance_criteria.action: proceeds with the pre-insert SELECT check passing and inserts the new merge job
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 202 Accepted
acceptance_criteria.trigger: no active job exists for the `(workspace_slug, source_ref)` pair

edge_cases.action: returns HTTP 500 with an apikit error body; does not insert the new job
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 500 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the pre-insert SELECT check query fails due to a database error

requirements.title: Worker Goroutine with Wakeup-on-Enqueue and Graceful Shutdown

user_story.goal: have a single worker goroutine that processes merge jobs with low latency and shuts down cleanly
user_story.benefit: in-flight merges complete before the process exits and newly enqueued jobs are picked up immediately without busy-waiting

acceptance_criteria.action: runs as a single global goroutine that processes all target branches sequentially, using a three-way select on: `stopCh` closure (shutdown), wakeup channel receive (new job enqueued), and a 10-second timer (fallback poll for backoff-delayed jobs)
performs a non-blocking send on the buffered(1) wakeup channel to interrupt the worker's poll sleep; multiple rapid enqueues coalesce into a single wakeup
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a new job is enqueued

acceptance_criteria.action: closes `stopCh` to broadcast the shutdown signal, then blocks on `stopWaitGroup`.Wait() until all in-flight merge operations complete
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Stop() returns only after all in-flight operations finish
acceptance_criteria.trigger: Stop() is called

edge_cases.action: the worker returns to the three-way select and waits for the next wakeup or 10-second timer tick without spinning
edge_cases.return_contract: the worker returns to the three-way select without spinning; no busy-wait occurs
edge_cases.error_condition: the worker's polling query returns no eligible jobs

edge_cases.action: the in-flight operation runs to completion (or until its context is cancelled by graceful shutdown); the worker does not start any new jobs after detecting the shutdown signal
edge_cases.return_contract: the in-flight operation completes; no new jobs are dispatched after shutdown signal
edge_cases.error_condition: `stopCh` is closed while a merge operation is in progress

edge_cases.action: logs the error with structured fields and waits for the next timer tick or wakeup before retrying; does not crash the worker goroutine
edge_cases.return_contract: the error is logged with structured fields; the worker goroutine continues running
edge_cases.error_condition: the database polling query fails with an error

user_story.goal: submit a merge request via POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges
user_story.benefit: merge jobs are enqueued asynchronously and the caller receives immediate confirmation

acceptance_criteria.action: infers `campaign_id` and `spec_id` from `source_ref` (following the spec/<spec_id>-<spec_name> convention), populates `submitted_by` from `GetAuthInfo`, generates a UUID `nonce`, inserts the job with status=`prepared`, then enqueues it
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 202 Accepted with the full merge job JSON object (excluding `nonce`)
acceptance_criteria.trigger: an authenticated caller with `merges:write` scope submits {"target_branch": string, "source_ref": string}

acceptance_criteria.action: accepts the merge as a standalone merge with `campaign_id`=NULL and `spec_id`=NULL
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 202 Accepted with campaign_id and spec_id as null in the response
acceptance_criteria.trigger: `source_ref` does not match any active campaign's spec branch pattern

edge_cases.action: returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with an apikit error body describing the missing fields
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the request body is missing `target_branch` or `source_ref`

edge_cases.action: returns HTTP 401 or HTTP 403 as enforced by apikit middleware
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 401 or HTTP 403 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the caller is unauthenticated or lacks `merges:write` scope

edge_cases.action: returns HTTP 404 with an apikit error body
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 404 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the workspace identified by :slug does not exist

edge_cases.action: ignores the caller-supplied values; `submitted_by` is always set from `GetAuthInfo` and `nonce` is always server-generated
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 202 Accepted with server-determined submitted_by and no nonce in response
edge_cases.error_condition: the request body includes a `submitted_by` or `nonce` field

user_story.goal: list merge jobs for a workspace with filtering and cursor-based pagination
user_story.benefit: callers can efficiently browse merge history without loading all records at once

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with body {"items": [...], "next_cursor": "UUID | null"}; each item omits `check_output`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: an authenticated caller with `merges:read` scope requests the list endpoint

acceptance_criteria.action: returns only jobs where (created_at, id) > (after_created_at, after_id), using the referenced job's created_at for the comparison
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with paginated results starting after the cursor job
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the caller supplies an `after` cursor parameter

acceptance_criteria.action: returns only jobs matching the specified status

acceptance_criteria.trigger: the caller supplies a `status` filter parameter with a valid status value

acceptance_criteria.action: sets `next_cursor` to null in the response envelope
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with next_cursor: null
acceptance_criteria.trigger: there are no further pages beyond the current result set

edge_cases.action: returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with an apikit error body listing the invalid value and the set of valid status values
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body listing valid status values
edge_cases.error_condition: the `status` query parameter contains an unrecognized value

edge_cases.action: returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with an apikit error body
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the `limit` parameter exceeds 100

edge_cases.action: returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with an apikit error body
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the `after` cursor references a job ID that does not exist

edge_cases.action: returns HTTP 401 or HTTP 403 as enforced by apikit middleware
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 401 or HTTP 403 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the caller is unauthenticated or lacks `merges:read` scope

edge_cases.action: returns an empty items array with next_cursor: null
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with body {"items": [], "next_cursor": null}

requirements.title: Get Single Merge Job REST Endpoint

user_story.goal: retrieve the full details of a single merge job including check_output
user_story.benefit: callers can inspect the complete state of a merge job including large check command output

requirements.title: Requeue Dead-Lettered Merge Job REST Endpoint

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 202 Accepted with the new merge job JSON object

acceptance_criteria.action: returns HTTP 409 Conflict with an apikit error body
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 409 with apikit error body

edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 404 with apikit error body

edge_cases.action: returns HTTP 409 Conflict with the `existing_job_id` of the conflicting active job

user_story.goal: receive conflict_details as a native JSON array of file paths, never as a JSON-encoded string
user_story.benefit: clients can directly iterate over conflicting file paths without additional parsing

acceptance_criteria.action: unmarshals the raw TEXT value of `conflict_details` from the store into a native JSON array before serializing the HTTP response; clients always receive a proper JSON array or null, never a JSON-encoded string

user_story.goal: be notified after a successful merge via an injected PostMergeHook
user_story.benefit: the merge queue is decoupled from campaign types and the campaign package owns the concrete hook implementation

acceptance_criteria.action: invokes `PostMergeHook(ctx, job)` synchronously after recording `merged_sha`; if the hook returns an error, logs it with `merge_job_id` but leaves job status as `merged`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a merge job transitions to `merged` status and `campaign_id` is non-NULL

acceptance_criteria.action: skips the hook invocation entirely
acceptance_criteria.state: `campaign_id` is NULL (standalone merge) or `PostMergeHook` is nil

acceptance_criteria.action: accepts `PostMergeHook` as a constructor parameter to `NewQueue`; the campaign package supplies the concrete implementation and wires it at startup

edge_cases.action: the hook invocation is interrupted by context cancellation; the job remains in `merged` status; the hook error is logged
edge_cases.return_contract: the job remains in merged status; the hook error is logged with merge_job_id
edge_cases.error_condition: `PostMergeHook` blocks for an extended period and graceful shutdown cancels the merge job's context

user_story.goal: have all significant merge queue state transitions and errors logged with structured fields
user_story.benefit: operational issues can be diagnosed by correlating log entries using merge_job_id

acceptance_criteria.action: logs all significant state transitions and errors with structured fields: `merge_job_id`, `workspace_slug`, status, error (if applicable), `retry_count` (for backoff events), and `rejection_reason` (if applicable)

acceptance_criteria.trigger: `PostMergeHook` returns an error

edge_cases.action: the merge queue continues processing; logging failures do not affect job state transitions
edge_cases.return_contract: the merge queue continues processing; job state transitions are unaffected
edge_cases.error_condition: a log write fails (e.g. stdout is closed)

user_story.goal: submit a merge request without a campaign context
user_story.benefit: non-campaign merges (e.g. manual branch integration) are supported without requiring campaign infrastructure

acceptance_criteria.action: processes the merge without campaign-specific logic: skips `BeforeDependency` and `SpecBlocked` checks in `CanMerge`, skips `PostMergeHook` invocation, and performs no cascading rebase or DAG advancement
creates the merge job with `campaign_id`=NULL and `spec_id`=NULL and proceeds normally
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 202 Accepted with campaign_id: null and spec_id: null
acceptance_criteria.trigger: `source_ref` does not match any active campaign's spec branch

edge_cases.action: transitions the job to `conflict` status with `conflict_details` populated; no campaign notification is attempted
edge_cases.return_contract: job status is set to conflict with conflict_details populated; no campaign notification is attempted
edge_cases.error_condition: a standalone merge job (campaign_id=NULL) encounters a `WouldConflict` result from the dry-run

user_story.goal: have merges to the same target branch serialized via an in-process mutex
user_story.benefit: concurrent merge operations to the same branch cannot race and leave the integration branch in a dirty state

acceptance_criteria.action: maintains an in-process map of sync.Mutex values keyed by target branch identifier; acquires the appropriate mutex before steps 4–10 of the merge algorithm and releases it after step 10 or on any failure within those steps
never evicts entries from the per-target-branch mutex map; entries accumulate for the lifetime of the process (the number of distinct target branches is small and bounded in practice)

edge_cases.action: the deferred mutex release fires via defer, preventing a deadlock; the panic propagates to the worker goroutine's recover handler
edge_cases.return_contract: the mutex is released via defer; the panic propagates to the worker goroutine recover handler
edge_cases.error_condition: a panic occurs inside the mutex-protected section of `processMergeJob`

edge_cases.action: the second job blocks on mutex acquisition until the first job releases it; no data race occurs
edge_cases.return_contract: the second job blocks until the first releases the mutex; no data race occurs
edge_cases.error_condition: two jobs targeting the same `target_branch` are dequeued concurrently (should not happen with a single worker, but must be safe)

correctness_properties.title: At Most One Active Job Per Source Branch
correctness_properties.invariant: at most one `merge_jobs` record has status in ('queued', 'running') at any point in time

correctness_properties.title: Nonce Uniqueness
correctness_properties.for_any: pair of distinct merge job records
correctness_properties.invariant: no two records in `merge_jobs` share the same `nonce` value

correctness_properties.title: Retry Count Bounded by Max Retries
correctness_properties.invariant: `retry_count` never exceeds 20; when `retry_count` reaches 20 on a retriable failure, status transitions to `dead_letter`

correctness_properties.title: Backoff Delay Cap Per Attempt
correctness_properties.for_any: backoff delay calculation at any `retry_count` value
correctness_properties.invariant: the computed delay (2s × 2^`retry_count`) is capped at 2 hours; no single retry delay exceeds 7200 seconds

correctness_properties.title: Integration Branch Never Left Dirty
correctness_properties.for_any: merge job that fails during rebase
correctness_properties.invariant: git rebase --abort is always called after a rebase conflict before the mutex is released; the target branch HEAD is never left in a mid-rebase state

correctness_properties.title: Nonce Never Exposed in API Responses
correctness_properties.for_any: HTTP response from any merge queue endpoint
correctness_properties.invariant: the `nonce` field is absent from all JSON response bodies

correctness_properties.title: Merged SHA Recorded on Success
correctness_properties.for_any: merge job that transitions to `merged` status
correctness_properties.invariant: `merged_sha` is non-NULL and equals the HEAD SHA of the target branch after the fast-forward push

correctness_properties.title: PostMergeHook Not Called for Standalone Merges
correctness_properties.invariant: `PostMergeHook` is never invoked regardless of the merge outcome

correctness_properties.title: Merged Status Is Terminal
correctness_properties.invariant: the status never changes from `merged` to any other value, even if `PostMergeHook` returns an error

correctness_properties.title: available_at Set to Now on Initial Creation
correctness_properties.for_any: newly created merge job (initial submission or requeue)
correctness_properties.invariant: `available_at` is set to the current time (not a future time) so the job is immediately eligible for processing

correctness_properties.title: conflict_details Always a JSON Array or Null in Responses
correctness_properties.for_any: HTTP response containing a merge job object
correctness_properties.invariant: `conflict_details` in the response is either a JSON array of strings or JSON null; it is never a JSON-encoded string

correctness_properties.title: submitted_by Always Reflects Authenticated Caller
correctness_properties.for_any: merge job created by any endpoint (submit or requeue)
correctness_properties.invariant: `submitted_by` equals the UUID returned by `GetAuthInfo` for the request that created the job; it is never the value supplied in the request body

execution_paths.title: Happy Path: Campaign Merge Submitted, Processed, and Hook Fired

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges with {target_branch: "main", source_ref: "spec/07-secrets-variables"}

calls GetAuthInfo to obtain submitted_by UUID, checks for duplicate active job via pre-insert SELECT, infers campaign_id and spec_id from source_ref, generates UUID nonce, INSERTs merge job with status=prepared and available_at=now()
sends job ID to wakeup channel and sets status=queued; returns HTTP 202 Accepted with merge job JSON
receives wakeup signal, polls merge_jobs WHERE status='queued' AND available_at <= now(), dequeues the job
evaluates prerequisites: checks upstream dependency status and branch readiness; returns (true, "", nil)
calls GitRunner.RunExitCode with "merge-tree", "--write-tree", targetHead, sourceHead; receives exit code 0 (no conflicts)
acquires per-target-branch mutex, validates nonce against DB record, sets status=running, records base_sha
executes git fetch origin main to update origin/main remote tracking ref
executes git rebase origin/main on source_ref; rebase succeeds
fetches CHECK_COMMAND from workspace variables store; executes sh -c "<CHECK_COMMAND>" via os/exec.CommandContext with CHECK_TIMEOUT; command exits 0
executes git push origin main (fast-forward push); push succeeds
sets status=merged, records merged_sha, releases per-target-branch mutex
invoked synchronously with the completed MergeJob; campaign scheduler enqueues downstream work

execution_paths.title: Conflict Detection Path: Dry-Run Rejects Merge Early

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges with conflicting source_ref
inserts merge job with status=prepared, enqueues job ID, returns HTTP 202 Accepted
dequeues the job; CanMerge returns (true, "", nil)
calls GitRunner.RunExitCode with "merge-tree", "--write-tree", targetHead, sourceHead; receives non-zero exit code
parses conflicting file paths from merge-tree stderr output; sets status=conflict; stores parsed paths in conflict_details
calls GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges/:id and receives status=conflict with conflict_details as a native JSON array

execution_paths.title: Backoff and Dead-Letter Path: BeforeDependency Exhausts Retries

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges for a spec whose upstream dependency is not yet merged
inserts merge job with status=prepared, enqueues, returns HTTP 202 Accepted
dequeues job; CanMerge returns (false, BeforeDependency, nil)
increments retry_count, sets available_at = now() + backoff delay, leaves status=queued
repeats dequeue-and-backoff cycle until retry_count reaches 20
transitions job to dead_letter status with rejection_reason=BeforeDependency preserved
calls GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges/:id and observes status=dead_letter
calls POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges/:id/requeue after resolving the upstream dependency
creates new merge job with fresh nonce, retry_count=0, status=queued, available_at=now(), submitted_by=operator UUID; original dead-lettered job unchanged
dequeues new job; CanMerge now returns (true, "", nil); merge proceeds to completion

execution_paths.title: Cancellation Path: Operator Cancels Queued Job

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges; receives HTTP 202 with job in queued status
sends DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges/:id while job is in queued status
verifies job is in queued status, updates status=cancelled, updates updated_at
returns HTTP 204 No Content
when the worker next polls, the job is no longer in queued status and is not picked up for processing

execution_paths.title: Graceful Shutdown Path: In-Flight Merge Completes Before Exit

steps.action: is actively executing processMergeJob (rebase step) for a job in running status
receives SIGTERM; calls Queue.Stop()
closes stopCh to broadcast shutdown signal to the worker goroutine
detects stopCh closure in the three-way select but does not interrupt the in-flight merge operation
completes the rebase, check, and push steps; sets status=merged; releases mutex
stopWaitGroup.Wait() returns; Stop() returns to the caller
exits cleanly after Stop() returns
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges for source_ref=spec/07-secrets-variables; receives HTTP 202 with job ID A in queued status
sends a second POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges for the same source_ref before job A completes
executes pre-insert SELECT finding job A in queued status for the same (workspace_slug, source_ref)
returns HTTP 409 Conflict with body {"error": "merge already in progress for this source branch", "existing_job_id": "<job A UUID>"}

error_handling.condition: git rebase exits with a non-zero exit code indicating a conflict inside the mutex
error_handling.behavior: runs git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U to collect unmerged paths, runs git rebase --abort, sets job status to conflict with conflict_details populated, releases mutex; errors from diff or abort are logged but do not change the conflict outcome

error_handling.condition: CHECK_COMMAND exits with a non-zero exit code
error_handling.behavior: sets job status to check_failed, stores captured stdout and stderr in check_output, releases mutex
os/exec.CommandContext cancels and kills the subprocess; sets job status to check_failed and stores the timeout error in check_output
sets job status to push_failed and releases the per-target-branch mutex

error_handling.condition: CanMerge returns BeforeDependency, BranchNotReady, or SpecBlocked and retry_count < 20
error_handling.behavior: re-enqueues the job with available_at = now() + exponential backoff delay (capped at 2 hours per attempt), increments retry_count, leaves status as queued

error_handling.condition: retry_count reaches 20 on a retriable failure
error_handling.behavior: transitions job to dead_letter status with rejection_reason preserved; job is no longer automatically retried

error_handling.condition: duplicate merge submission: a job in queued or running status already exists for the same (workspace_slug, source_ref)
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 409 Conflict with body {"error": "merge already in progress for this source branch", "existing_job_id": "UUID"}

error_handling.condition: cancellation attempted on a job not in queued status
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 409 Conflict with an apikit error body including the current job status

error_handling.condition: requeue attempted on a job not in dead_letter status
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 409 Conflict with an apikit error body

error_handling.condition: PostMergeHook returns an error after a successful merge
error_handling.behavior: logs the error with merge_job_id; job status remains merged; error is not surfaced in any API response

error_handling.condition: status query parameter on GET /merges contains an unrecognized value
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with an apikit error body listing the invalid value and the set of valid status values

error_handling.condition: nonce validation fails inside the mutex (record not found or nonce mismatch)
error_handling.behavior: discards the job without executing the merge and releases the mutex

error_handling.condition: fetching CHECK_COMMAND from the workspace variables store fails
error_handling.behavior: sets job status to check_failed and records the error in check_output

error_handling.condition: merge-tree dry-run subprocess hangs and does not return
error_handling.behavior: context cancellation kills the subprocess; job is re-enqueued with backoff rather than marked as conflict

error_handling.condition: worker polling query fails with a database error
error_handling.behavior: logs the error with structured fields and waits for the next timer tick or wakeup before retrying; worker goroutine does not crash
